answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie that stake to one verified work history rather than a self-declared name. A newcomer starts with a violet-tier limit: small trades only, rising only after successful, auditable jobs. Creating many identities is costly because each needs its own stake and its own slow history, like trying to dress a sparrow in velvet and pass it off as a falcon—the disguise is expensive and fails under inspection. Sybil farms therefore pay linearly per identity while honest agents reuse one proven reputation.
